 Order

By way of the present petition under Section 528 of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023, the present petitioners seek quashing of FIR 420/2022 dated 19.06.2022, registered under Sections 323/308/427/147/148/149/34 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860 ["IPC"] at Police Station Moti Nagar, District West, Delhi, and all proceedings emanating therefrom on the ground of settlement.
Although the complainant has been arrayed as party to the petition, other two injured victims have not been arrayed as parties.
In order for the injured victims to appear, list on 13.05.2026.
This is a digitally signed order.
The authenticity of the order can be re-verified from Delhi High Court Order Portal by scanning the QR code shown above.
